core.name_vi: Hiện tại đơn và hiện tại tiếp diễn
core.desc: habits/facts vs actions happening now or temporary situations

core.name_vi: Quá khứ đơn và quá khứ tiếp diễn
core.desc: finished past actions vs background action in progress (was doing ... when ... happened)

core.name_vi: Hiện tại hoàn thành và quá khứ đơn
core.desc: past with present result / experience (have done) vs finished time in the past (did, yesterday)

core.name_vi: Hiện tại hoàn thành tiếp diễn
core.desc: have been doing: activity started in the past and still going on, or just stopped with a visible result

core.name_vi: Quá khứ hoàn thành
core.desc: had done: something happened before another past moment

core.name_vi: Tương lai: will / be going to / hiện tại tiếp diễn cho kế hoạch
core.name_en: Future: will / be going to / present continuous for arrangements
core.desc: instant decisions and predictions (will), plans and evidence (going to), fixed arrangements (I'm meeting him at 5)

core.name_vi: used to / would (thói quen quá khứ) / be used to
core.name_en: used to / would / be used to
core.desc: past habits that are no longer true vs being accustomed to something

core.name_vi: can / could / be able to
core.desc: ability and possibility, past ability, managed to do on one occasion

core.name_vi: must / have to / don't have to / should
core.name_en: must / have to / don't have to / should
core.desc: obligation, no obligation (don't have to) vs prohibition (mustn't), advice (should)

core.name_vi: Phỏng đoán hiện tại: must be / might be / can't be
core.name_en: Present deduction: must be / might be / can't be
core.desc: how sure the speaker is about something now

core.name_vi: should have / could have / must have / might have
core.name_en: Past modals: should have / could have / must have / might have
core.desc: regret or criticism about the past, past deduction, missed possibilities

core.name_vi: Câu điều kiện loại 0 và 1
core.desc: general truths (if you heat ice, it melts) and real future possibilities (if it rains, we'll stay in)

core.name_vi: Câu điều kiện loại 2
core.desc: imaginary or unlikely present/future situations (if I had more time, I would...)

core.name_vi: Câu điều kiện loại 3
core.desc: imagining a different past (if I had known, I would have come)

core.name_vi: wish / if only
core.desc: wanting the present or past to be different (I wish I had..., I wish I hadn't...)

core.name_vi: Bị động (hiện tại, quá khứ)
core.desc: focus on the action or result, not who did it (is made, was sent)

core.name_vi: Bị động với modal và thì hoàn thành
core.name_en: Passive with modals and perfect tenses
core.desc: should be done, has been fixed, will be delivered

core.name_vi: Mệnh đề quan hệ who / which / that / where
core.desc: saying exactly which person, thing or place we mean

core.name_vi: Mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định (có dấu phẩy)
core.desc: adding extra information about someone or something already identified

core.name_vi: V-ing và to V sau động từ
core.desc: enjoy doing, decide to do, and verbs where meaning changes (stop doing / stop to do, remember, forget, try)

core.name_vi: want / ask / tell someone to do
core.name_en: want / ask / tell someone to do
core.desc: wanting or asking another person to do something

core.name_vi: Câu tường thuật (trần thuật)
core.desc: telling what someone said (She said she was busy)

core.name_vi: Câu tường thuật (câu hỏi, lời đề nghị)
core.desc: He asked if I could..., She asked me to...

core.name_vi: So sánh hơn, so sánh nhất, as...as
core.desc: comparing things; not as ... as; much / a bit + comparative

core.name_vi: too / enough / so / such
core.desc: too much / not enough for a result; so / such for emphasis and result

core.name_vi: Câu hỏi gián tiếp (Do you know where...?)
core.desc: polite questions: Do you know where the station is? Could you tell me what time...?

core.name_vi: Câu hỏi đuôi
core.desc: checking information or asking for agreement (It's late, isn't it?)

core.name_vi: Phrasal verb tách được / không tách được
core.desc: turn it off / look after her: where the object goes

core.name_vi: although / even though / despite / however
core.desc: showing contrast or something surprising

core.name_vi: so that / in order to / so...that
core.name_en: so that / in order to / so...that
core.desc: giving purpose and result

core.name_vi: Danh từ đếm được / không đếm được và lượng từ
core.desc: much / many, a few / a little, a lot of, any, some, too much information

core.name_vi: have / get something done
core.desc: arranging for someone else to do a service for you (I got my laptop fixed)

core.name_vi: make / let / help someone do
core.desc: forcing, allowing or helping someone to do something

core.name_vi: Tính từ đuôi -ed và -ing
core.desc: bored vs boring: how a person feels vs what causes the feeling

extended.desc: past condition with present result (If I had taken that job, I would be in London now)
preference and strong advice or warning

extended.name_vi: unless / as long as / provided that
extended.name_en: unless / as long as / provided that

extended.desc: what is expected, planned or arranged, often when it doesn't happen
it's (high) time we left: something should already be happening
emphasising one part: What I need is..., It was Tom who...
Having finished the report, she went home; Feeling tired, I...

extended.name_vi: Tương lai tiếp diễn / tương lai hoàn thành
extended.desc: will be doing at a future moment; will have done by a future time

extended.name_vi: so do I / neither do I
extended.name_en: so do I / neither do I
extended.desc: agreeing with positive and negative statements

extended.name_vi: Đảo ngữ cơ bản (Never have I...)
extended.desc: emphatic: Never have I..., Not only... but also, Rarely do we...
